The '''Panela system''' was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Panelan feast]], a traditional event in the [[Standard year/Legends|annual]] [[Marqua Spas Grand Ball]] that was held on the<ref name="GNN">{{JournalCite|9|Galaxywide NewsNets}}</ref> [[Gailea system/Legends|Gailea system's]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|307|Gailea}}</ref> [[Gailea]].<ref name="GNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Panela [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA" />
